rationale: Georgi is building Rilo, an AI-agents platform for GTM automation that helps startups replace manual sales and marketing workflows—a use case that directly overlaps with Symphony Creative Studio's work on AI-powered creative tools for advertisers and performance marketing. Georgi's conviction that AI agents should own outcomes (not just tasks) and his focus on helping small teams punch above their weight through automation complements Symphony's expertise in generative AI and creator tooling; they could explore how agentic workflows might enhance AI-driven ad creative generation and distribution.
intro_message: Symphony Creative Studio, meet Georgi—you're both building in generative AI and performance marketing automation, and Georgi is actively hiring for GTM roles at Rilo where your adtech and creative tooling background could add real value.
